note: Forty-nine requests and the catalogue items of release 29a2bc33c313... (256,380 items) that answer each. Ten requests are the queries observed during the October 16, 2026 launch customer journey (finding F-5) and the comparison pilot retrieval diagnostic (artifacts/comparison-pilot-2026-10-16/results/retrieval-diagnostic.json). Thirty-nine similar coding-tool requests were written on October 16, 2026 before any ranking output was read for them. Each relevant list is defined by a topic rule over item purposes and identities without calling any ranking engine; two competition-specific queries have an empty relevant list because the catalogue holds no competition dataset or solution.

authors.search_ranking_session_2026_10_16: the engineering session of 2026-10-16 that measured ranking policies over release 29a2bc33c313...; it changed no catalogue item

split_rule.held_back_when: the first eight hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256 digest of the query text, read as a base sixteen number, leave no remainder when divided by four
split_rule.why: the split follows from the query text, so no result can move a query between the two groups

relevance_sets.changelog: The item writes, generates, updates, structures or validates a changelog or release notes as one of its stated functions. Items that only read other projects' changelogs, show a tool's own changelog, or wrap a third-party API's change-log endpoint are not relevant.
relevance_sets.release_notes_from_history: The item writes release notes or a changelog from commits, pull requests or git history.
relevance_sets.cache_expiry: The item designs or implements an application cache or memoization with expiry, time to live or an eviction policy such as least recently used.
relevance_sets.dotenv: The item reads, parses, loads, validates or manages .env files, or loads settings from environment variables.
relevance_sets.debug_regression: The item debugs software: reproduces a bug, regression or failing test and finds its root cause in code. Root-cause analysis of business metrics, incidents outside code, or one vendor's product is not relevant.
relevance_sets.bisect: The item finds the commit or change that introduced a bug, for example with git bisect.
relevance_sets.kaggle: The item works with Kaggle competitions, datasets or submissions.
relevance_sets.tabular_classification: The item helps build or evaluate a supervised model on tabular data: scikit-learn or gradient boosting use, classification metrics, validation splits and leakage checks.
relevance_sets.gradient_boosting: The item installs, configures or explains gradient boosting libraries (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) or gradient boosted trees.
relevance_sets.grouped_validation: The item checks validation splits for leakage, including grouped or time-based splits, or reads the gap between training and validation scores.
relevance_sets.spec_to_code: The item implements code from a specification, documentation or an existing test suite, including test-driven development.
relevance_sets.regex: The item writes, explains or tests regular expressions, or parses quoted and escaped strings.
relevance_sets.conventional_commits: The item writes or checks commit messages, including the Conventional Commits format.
relevance_sets.semver: The item chooses or bumps a version number for a release, including semantic versioning.
relevance_sets.time_series: The item forecasts a time series or models time-series data.
relevance_sets.url_validation: The item validates, normalizes or parses URLs or website addresses.
relevance_sets.dedupe: The item finds or removes duplicate rows or records in tabular data.
relevance_sets.unit_tests: The item writes or runs unit tests for code (Python or general), or practises test-first changes.
relevance_sets.rate_limit: The item rate-limits requests or retries them with backoff.
relevance_sets.dockerfile: The item writes or reviews Dockerfiles or container images for a service.
relevance_sets.github_actions: The item writes, reviews or fixes GitHub Actions or CI workflows.
relevance_sets.pre_commit: The item configures pre-commit or other git hooks.
relevance_sets.markdown_lint: The item lints or formats Markdown files.
relevance_sets.pr_description: The item writes the title or description of a pull request.
relevance_sets.profile_python: The item profiles code to find slow parts, in Python or in general.
relevance_sets.json_format: The item formats, pretty-prints or reshapes JSON output.
relevance_sets.csv_to_json: The item converts CSV to JSON or between tabular file formats including both.
relevance_sets.link_check: The item finds broken or dead links in documents or sites.
relevance_sets.readme: The item writes or updates a project README.
relevance_sets.log_summary: The item reads, parses, analyzes or summarizes log files.
